caption: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a mannequin dressed in a long, formal gown. The mannequin has a smooth, stylized face with painted features and is adorned with dark hair styled in ringlets, further decorated with flowers. The entire image is rendered in shades of gray, as is characteristic of grayscale photography.
title: Wedding Dress
